messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY BLOCKED] rc6 -> prod halted. Reason: SBOM present but cosign signature verification failed for registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc6. Vulnerability scan flags: 1 MEDIUM CVE (CVE-2025-9999) in transitive 'archive-lib'. Change window closes in ~1.5h. Ping @marta @bryce.

marta (release-manager): thanks. Short options: rollback, pin to previous signed digest + canary, or exception with mitigations. Need decision in 40m.

bryce (security): quick notes: MEDIUM transitive, no exploit reported. Preferred: pin to last signed image for canary or require signed SBOM before full rollout. Exception acceptable if timeboxed and monitored.

dmitri: checking registry for previous signed digest...

$ skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood.com/runtime:rc6
Digest: sha256:feedbeefcafebabecafe1234567890aa
Signatures: cosign: verification FAILED (no matching signatures)
SBOM: present
Vulns: CVE-2025-9999 (MEDIUM) via archive-lib 2.1.0

dmitri: previous signed digest available: sha256:00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff (signed). That image lacks the rc6 feature toggle.

sara (qa): we can run focused security smoke + regression in ~30m on a small canary.

marta: proposal: EU-only canary pinned to signed rc5 digest (sha256:001122...) at 2% traffic for 4h while we get cosign attached or hotpatch. If canary stable, schedule promote after SBOM signature. Legal/Security to approve.

bryce (security): approve timeboxed 4h pinned canary under controls: (1) auto-rollback on errors>0.5% or latency_p50>25% over baseline for 5m, (2) increased logging and EDR tracing, (3) security to be paged on anomalies.

legal: approve with audit note requirement and ticket REL-4899 referenced in release notes. Timebox enforced.

dmitri: configuring carveout. Command: deploybot carveout --region eu-west-1 --image "registry.redwood.com/runtime@sha256:00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff" --traffic 2% --rollback-if "errors>0.5% or latency_p50>25%" --expire 4h

deploy-bot: carving out canary to eu-west-1 using pinned digest sha256:00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff. Traffic: 2%. Auto-rollback rules set. Expiry: 4h.

sara (qa): smoke started, quick health checks show no 5xx spike. Regression subset queued (ETA 20m).

dmitri: monitoring hooks and alert rules set to notify #eng-oncall and #security.

marta: I'll append exception text to release notes: "Temporary EU canary pinned to sha256:001122... due to cosign verification failure on rc6. Timeboxed 4h pending signed SBOM or hotpatch. Security & Legal approved. Ticket REL-4899."

bryce (security): noted. If signed SBOM arrives, we'll re-verify and promote. If canary breaches thresholds or new exploit intel appears, auto-rollback will trigger.

deploy-bot: [LOG] canary-start ts=1716100300 status=running instances=3 health=3 traffic=2%

sara (qa): smoke full pass completed, regression subset running. Update in ~18m.

dmitri: all good so far. Will escalate if anything changes.

marta: decision recorded. Product wants +1h update.

(THREAD END)
